messages:
ana: Heads up: proposing a staged step-down of the runtime pin on hosted for model-serving. Not a hard unpin — idea is a controlled rollforward with automatic step-down if errors increase. Need quick alignment.
tom: +1. Can you outline the step-down steps? Curious about how deploybot and fallback routing interact.
ana: typo — 'ana' :) Plan sketch: 1) create a canary cohort (canary-small-us, canary-eu) at 10% traffic each. 2) apply runtime=3.1 with compatibility shim mode 'compat_safe'. 3) monitor 15m windows; if errors >2% or p99 > baseline+10%, step-down to runtime=2.14 for that cohort. 4) after 2 successful windows, increment cohorts to 25% -> 50% -> full.
rachel: QA: we need exact sample prompts and the canary selectors. Also request we freeze any schema changes in client streaming for the window.
sdk-team: SDK: streaming chunk boundary change is present in 3.1 but behind a feature flag. We can ship a patch enabling flag off by default; recommend enabling only after cohort reaches 50%.
deploybot: scheduling preflight checks for cohorts [canary-small-us,canary-eu] at 2026-04-05T08:00:00-07:00. Preflight window T-20m.
infra-bot: note: there's a maintenance window in us-east 2026-04-05T10:30-11:00 UTC. would conflict with progressive 50% -> 100% step if timed poorly.
tom: let's avoid overlapping. Move major step to after maintenance. Good catch.
nana: Adjusted schedule: preflight 08:40, cohort 10% at 09:00, expand to 25% at 11:30, 50% at 14:00. We'll block 10:30-11:15 for infra maintenance.
qa-runner: QA runbook: I'll run regression set 'canary-core' and 'longseq-stress'. Expect ~2 hours for baseline + 1st window verification. Need the exact manifest and route config by 07:30 PT.
nana: manifest snippet (for deployops):
```
runtime: 3.1
flags:
  compat_mode: compat_safe
cohorts: [canary-small-us, canary-eu]
concurrency_caps: 20%
```

sdk-team: We'll open PR: "js-sdk: expose streamingChunkGuard flag (off by default)" and add note in changelog.
tom: Ops: we'll also add a short-circuit routing rule: if errors >2% for 3m, route cohort->fallback-runtime. Implemented as: `routing_rule: if cohort.errors_pct > 2 then route = runtime:2.14`.
deploybot: preflight results: canary-eu PASS, canary-small-us PASS. Telemetry: no regression in eu, us small shows small 0.6% p99 rise but within tolerance.
nana: outstanding decisions: do we want automatic step-down or manual hold for each expansion? Auto step-down reduces human latency but could mask root cause. Thoughts?
rachel: prefer auto step-down but with immediate page and a 10m hold requiring human ack before next expansion. That gives safety + awareness.
sdk-team: agree. We'll keep flag off so older clients unaffected. Add a telemetry spike annotation to changelog.
nana: final plan: staged rollforward with compat_safe, auto step-down on error >2% for 3m, immediate page to oncall, 10m manual ack hold before next expansion, concurrency cap 20% for canary. Rollback cutoff EOD if unresolved.
tom: LGTM. I'll add a runbook step: how to forcibly pin back via deploybot CLI and who to notify: #eng-runtime, #eng-releases, #customer-success.
deploybot: scheduled rollout (staged) for 2026-04-05T09:00:00-07:00. cohorts: canary-small-us(10%), canary-eu(10%); auto-stepdown rule active.
infra-bot: reminder: ensure GPU drivers on canary hosts are at driver-571+ to avoid kernel mismatch.
nana: Thanks all. Rachel/QA: once you confirm first window, please post results here and I'll trigger the next expansion. Also publishing a short note to #eng-releases before the 09:00 start. :rocket:
